name: isohue
source: A test fixture in the shape of wl-xtasks' stimuli/isohue.json (pop-out plan, Task 9), not that file. wl-style 02-color/isohue_spectrum: blue (hue 260), purple (320) and red (20) are isohue_levels.csv's cone_macaque_equal rows at saturation 1; green (140) was computed with its isohue.py at the sector's chroma 29.49 under colour-science 0.4.7 on 2026-11-07 (sRGB preview #54a947); the apex is its reference gray #969696.
